packageRules.description: Wait 3 days before automerging major updates

Buffer mise (aqua/github-tags) tools 3 days. Two reasons: (1) a freshly-tagged release whose asset isn't published yet makes `mise install` 404 (the trivy 0.71.1 phantom-version incident); (2) it matches the npm 3-day buffer so a grouped pnpm bump (mise side + npm/Dockerfile side) becomes ready at the same time and lands atomically — otherwise the un-buffered mise side advances first and trips `check-toolchain-alignment`.
Group GitHub Actions into one PR
Group Dapr SDK + CLI + sidecar/dashboard images so they ship in lockstep
Group Makefile inline `# renovate:` tool versions

Disable digest pinning for Makefile-tracked docker tools (mermaid-cli, etc.). The `docker:pinDigests` preset (inherited from `config:best-practices`) otherwise generates a `pinDigest` update for `MERMAID_CLI_VERSION := 11.14.0`-style entries that have no digest yet. When a `non-major` version bump (11.14.0 → 11.15.0) is ALSO available, both updates target the same `renovate/makefile-tools` branch and collide; Renovate suppresses the version bump and the constant drifts silently. Makefile-tracked deps are dev/lint tools (mermaid-cli, depcheck, npm-check-updates, ZAP, renovate), not production runtime — version pinning is sufficient. Source: 2026-05-13 review — mermaid-cli stuck at 11.14.0 while 11.15.0 was available; debug log showed both `pinDigest` and `non-major` updates in `renovate/makefile-tools` with `Ignoring upgrade collision` suppressing the bump.
Group .mise.toml entries (extracted natively by the `mise` manager) into one PR

Group Docker base images managed by the built-in dockerfile + docker-compose managers. Restricted to those two managers (NOT also custom.regex) because a custom.regex docker-datasource dep that's ONLY in Makefile (e.g. `minlag/mermaid-cli`) has no compose/Dockerfile sibling to edit; including it here makes Renovate's collision-dedup suppress the bump entirely. Such Makefile-only docker deps fall back to the `Makefile tools` group above and bump normally. Placed LAST so it wins over the Makefile-tools / mise-tools rules above for the deps it does match. Source: 2026-05-13 review — `mermaid-cli` stuck at 11.14.0 while 11.15.0 was available because the previous unscoped `matchDatasources: [docker]` form trapped it.

Group Node.js version updates (mise + dockerfile + docker-compose). mise's lookup yields packageName 'node'; the dockerfile + docker-compose managers normalize to 'docker.io/node' — both forms must be listed so a Node-major bump lands on a single grouped branch instead of splitting across two PRs (silent drift trap).

Group pnpm across managers — mise pins `aqua:pnpm/pnpm` (github-tags), the npm manager reads `packageManager` field in `package.json` (npm datasource), and the Dockerfile customManager tracks `corepack prepare pnpm@X.Y.Z` literals (npm datasource). These three were silently drifting (mise advanced to 11.1.1 while Dockerfiles + package.json stayed at 11.0.9) because each manager opens its own PR on its own branch. matchPackageNames covers both depName shapes (`pnpm/pnpm` for the github-tags lookup and `pnpm` for the npm-datasource lookups). Group keeps them in lockstep going forward.

customManagers.description: Generic Makefile tool version manager — matches any `# renovate: ...` comment above a `NAME_VERSION := value` assignment
Track `corepack prepare pnpm@X.Y.Z` literals in Dockerfiles — keeps them in lockstep with package.json packageManager (npm manager tracks that field separately)
